generatedBy: hand-maintained; Reference/MDN has no extractor yet
policy: A reference document is retired once every name it defines is accounted for by the compiler, and the coverage tests exercise it. For an element or an attribute that means the name is registered, validated on the elements MDN says accept it, and routed to a typed native property; for a CSS property it means the compiler compiles it. A name that is only mentioned is not enough. The retired file is deleted and the deletion is recorded here, so the reference shrinks and the compiler's knowledge of what it once stated does not.
scope: The CSS and HTML reference material under Reference/MDN/files/en-us/web: css/reference/{properties,selectors,at-rules,values}, html/reference/{elements,attributes,global_attributes}. The rest of the MDN content repository (Web API, JavaScript, HTTP, and so on) is outside this compiler's subject.

documents.note: Lowered to a native PositionKind; static, relative, absolute, fixed and sticky are compiled.
A compiled offset resolved against the containing block; may be negative, and auto is a value.
A compiled offset; places an out-of-flow box against the containing block's right edge.
A compiled offset; places an out-of-flow box against the containing block's bottom edge.
A compiled offset; places an out-of-flow box against the containing block's left edge.
Compiled as an integer or auto; carried on the native style with a presence flag so auto is not zero. A levelled positioned box now paints and hit tests in stacking order, not tree order.
Expanded to the four offset longhands by the cascade, with the same 1-to-4 distribution as margin.
Lowered to a native FloatKind; a float is placed against a side of its block, leaves the line flow, and the lines crossing its box are shortened around it.
Lowered to a native ClearKind; a cleared block is pushed below the floats on the side it names before it is placed.
Lowered to a native FlexDirectionKind; row, row-reverse, column and column-reverse select the main axis.
Lowered to a native flex factor; a positive factor shares the free main-axis space with its siblings.
Lowered to a native shrink factor; when the items overflow, each shrinks in proportion to factor times base size.
Lowered to an unresolved LayoutValue; it is the item's initial main size, with auto falling back to its own size and a zero basis respected as a real basis.
Lowered to a native integer; items are laid out in ascending order, ties in tree order.
Lowered to a native JustifyContentKind; flex-start, flex-end, center, space-between, space-around and space-evenly distribute the free main-axis space.
Lowered to a native AlignItemsKind; stretch, flex-start, flex-end, center and baseline place items on the cross axis.
Lowered to a native AlignItemsKind plus a presence flag; auto defers to the container's align-items.

notes: The CSS Working Group drafts and the WHATWG HTML drafts were consumed before this reference arrived, so the compiler already accounts for 1,080 CSS property names and the HTML vocabulary those drafts define. Reference/MDN is a second, differently structured reference: one Markdown page per item, which is why it is walked page by page rather than mined by an extractor.

A property name the compiler carries is known, parsed and stored but not compiled: it keeps its declared value and is reported as an unimplemented feature (RCC010) rather than refused. Implementing one means compiling it and giving it its rendering behaviour.

The 59 CSS property names MDN has that no draft of the reference defined are the vendor-prefixed set, the legacy flexbox box-* set, the SVG presentation attributes (which are SVG attribute vocabulary, not CSS properties) and touch-action, math-*, corner-*-shape, user-modify and font-smooth.

The out-of-flow model (position, top, right, bottom, left, inset, z-index) was the first slice of the layout machinery: the offsets and the shorthand are compiled and lowered, layout shifts relative and sticky boxes and places absolute and fixed boxes against their containing block, and a fixed box is pinned to the viewport through scrolling in paint, hit testing and bounds.

The float model (float, clear) was the second slice of the layout machinery: both are compiled and lowered, a float is placed shrink-to-fit against its side and its container grows to contain it, the line boxes crossing it lose its width, and clear drops a box below the floats it names.

The single-line flex model (display: flex, flex-direction, justify-content, align-items, align-self, flex-grow, flex-shrink, flex-basis and order) was the third slice of the layout machinery. The container lays its items along one axis, distributes free space by the growth factors, shrinks when they overflow, and sorts them by order. flex-wrap, flex-flow, align-content, the flex shorthand and gap are not part of this slice and their pages stay.
